title: Promise with Ye Qing
next_chapter_hook: When Ye Qing's figure vanished into the night, Chen Ji tightly gripped the blood-stained Jade Pendant in his hand, an uneasy feeling rising in his heart—Ling Yuan's chess game had already been set in motion, and who would be the next piece he aimed to take?

text.content: The calligraphy of the Ling family's advisor struck like thunder, pulling Chen Ji back to reality from his momentary calm. He folded the impeachment memorial and tucked it into his sleeve, his expression already restored to its usual state—even carrying a hint of nonchalant smile. What's the rush? Now that the chess game is clear, breaking the situation is merely a matter of timing.

dialogue.content: (Fingertips tapping the desk lightly) Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan, did you think this memorial could do anything to me? It's just adding another variable... However, since the mastermind has revealed themselves, it saves me the trouble of guessing.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink. Chen Ji sat alone by the window, the cold moonlight carving a stern outline on his profile. Suddenly, a faint, ethereal fragrance drifted into the room—the Demonic Path's unique 'Mist Concealment Incense', utterly undetectable to ordinary cultivators. But Chen Ji had already set up perceptual barriers in the air, detecting the visitor's identity at once.

dialogue.content: (A voice emerged from the shadows, carrying a hint of languor) Chen Gongzi's perceptual barriers are indeed exquisite. Had I not cultivated the 'Mist Concealment Art', I might have been discovered before even getting close. Three years apart, your cultivation has improved considerably... It's just that this cautious approach hasn't changed at all.

text.content: Chen Ji did not rise, only speaking calmly: 'Ye Shengnv's Mist Concealment Art has also progressed remarkably. Had you not deliberately leaked your presence, even my triple-layered barriers would have stopped you.' He turned his head toward the window, gazing at the vaguely discernible figure wrapped in black纱, 'Speak. What's made you so eager to see me? A change of circumstances?'

dialogue.content: (Stepping slowly out of the shadows, the moonlight outlining her cold, elegant silhouette) Circumstances? Not quite. It's just... the Holy Sect seems to have noticed something. This time's ruins exploration, they've sent additional people—and the leader is 'Blood Slaughter Elder'.
(Pausing, her voice slightly lowered) Chen Ji, there's something I've... been hiding from you. Regarding the additional clause of our original agreement.

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly. He rose and walked toward Ye Qing, his gaze calm as still water: 'Speak.' Ye Qing met his gaze for a moment, then turned away, her voice so low it was barely audible: 'When I offered to cooperate with you, my condition was that our fates be bound together—but I didn't tell you the complete contents.'

dialogue.content: (Turning around, her tone平静得近乎冷漠) You die, I perish. That's the true content of the additional clause. The Holy Sect's Elder planted a 'Life Pact' on me. As long as your life force is severed, the contract will automatically take my life as compensation.

text.content: The room fell into dead silence. The fingers Chen Ji held his teacup with suddenly clenched tight, his knuckles turning white. He gazed at Ye Qing's eyes, which were平静得近乎空洞, and somewhere in his heart felt as if pierced by something sharp. Three years. She had hidden this from him for three whole years.

dialogue.content: (Voice low, carrying suppressed fury) Three years. You hid this from me for three years. Ye Qing, what kind of person do you take me for? A waste who needs a woman protecting with her life?

(A light laugh escaped her, yet there was no笑意 in her eyes) Waste? Chen Ji, if anyone in this world dares call you a waste, I would be the first to disbelieve. Three years ago, you set that deadly chess game against the encirclement of three major sects, slaughtering seven Golden Core Elders in one fell swoop—such means, where is the waste?

(Stepping closer, voice softening) When I agreed to cooperate with you back then, it wasn't because the Tianji Record's prophecy was so startling. It was the way you looked at me—with no greed, no fear, only... only a kind of startling calm. Like looking at an equal chess player, not some Demonic Path witch.

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before finally speaking, his voice hoarse: 'When you proposed the fate binding back then, I thought it was merely your way of showing loyalty. Now that I think about it, you clearly were—' He didn't finish, as if something had lodged in his throat.

dialogue.content: (Interrupting him, speaking softly) I clearly wanted to bind you, to ensure you couldn't die no matter what. Because... because only if you live do I have a reason to keep going. Those years at the Holy Sect, I was merely a golden canary kept in a cage, ready to be discarded at any moment. You gave me another choice.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Ye Qing's profound devotion offered with her life at stake?

choices.description: Acknowledge Ye Qing's importance to him, making a promise to protect her
choices.visible_cost: Lose his mask of surface coldness
choices.visible_reward: Establish a deeper bond with Ye Qing, unlocking the 'Shared Fate' prerequisite
choices.risk_hint: May expose his inner softness, which enemies could exploit

text.content: Chen Ji slowly approached Ye Qing, stopping before her. Moonlight fell through the window lattice, interweaving their shadows together. He reached out, fingertips gently touching her cheek, his movements as light as if fearing to disturb something fragile. 'Since you've entrusted your life to me—' his voice was low and solemn, 'then half of my life belongs to you as well.'

choices.memory_label: 夜清以命相托，陈机正式接受这份羁绊

choices.text: Rationally analyze the pros and cons
choices.description: Temporarily suppress emotions, first discuss how to break the Life Pact's shackles
choices.visible_reward: Gain clues for breaking the Life Pact, increasing subsequent action success rate
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might misunderstand his intentions

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression turning cold once more. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze deep and dark: 'I remember the matter of the Life Pact. But the most urgent thing now is to understand the Holy Sect's true purpose in sending reinforcements. Blood Slaughter Elder—what is this person's cultivation level? What weaknesses do they have?'

choices.description: Suspect whether Ye Qing is sincere, or acting as the Holy Sect's informant
choices.visible_reward: Probe Ye Qing's bottom line, confirming the possibility of double agency
choices.risk_hint: May completely destroy the relationship between them

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, looking at Ye Qing with a half-smile: 'Life Pact binding, life and death intertwined... Ye Shengnv's eloquence is touching indeed. I'm just curious—the Holy Sect wants you to monitor me, is this Life Pact a shackle, or one you voluntarily took upon yourself?'

Ye Qing listened quietly to Chen Ji's words, a bitter smile curving her lips. She didn't defend herself, only taking a blood-stained Jade Pendant from her sleeve and gently setting it on the table. The pendant bore an ancient rune, faintly emanating an ominous aura. 'This is everything I've collected over three years regarding the Life Pact.'

dialogue.content: (Fingers tracing the Jade Pendant) There's only one way to break it—to sever the Life Pact's connection before the contractor dies. But this requires one prerequisite: both parties of the Life Pact must possess sufficient Life Force, otherwise the moment of severance, the bound party will die from Life Force backlash.

(Eyes fixed on Chen Ji) So do you understand now? Me wanting you to live isn't just because I like you—it's because only if you live can I possibly gain freedom. If you die, I won't even have a chance to break free from these chains. This is the first time in three years I've told anyone the truth.

choice.prompt: After gaining the crucial intelligence, how does Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Promise to break the Life Pact
choices.description: Solemnly vow to find the Life Force and help Ye Qing gain freedom
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's affection increases significantly, gaining the 'Loyal Ally' title
choices.risk_hint: Requires consuming vast resources to search for Life Force

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Jade Pendant in his palm, his knuckles tightening until they turned white. He raised his gaze to meet Ye Qing's, his eyes carrying a kind of near-obsessive determination: 'Within three years, I will find the Life Force. At that time, I will personally sever this Life Pact for you.'

choices.memory_label: 陈机立下三年之约，誓言破解命契

choices.description: Propose terms for information exchange, indicating cooperation must be built on equality
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on Blood Slaughter Elder, providing crucial information for subsequent actions
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing might find him too calculating

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Pendant into his sleeve, his expression calm: 'You've given me hope for breaking the Life Pact. As equal exchange—tell me everything you know about Blood Slaughter Elder and the Tianji Pavilion ruins. We each take what we need, and we're even.'

Ye Qing heard this and sighed softly, yet a sense of relief appeared in her smile. She sat across from Chen Ji, fingers lightly tapping the table, and began to narrate in detail: 'The Tianji Pavilion ruins... The Holy Sect's true purpose isn't the magical artifacts or elixirs within, but a sealed ancient tome—'The Heaven's Mandate Return to Void Art'.'

dialogue.content: (Voice lowered) Legend says that tome contains the method to break free from Heaven's shackles. Blood Slaughter Elder's journey is precisely to seize this item the moment the ruins open. As for the three major sects... They're kept in the dark, thinking this is merely a ordinary secret realm exploration.

text.content: After hearing this, a sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. 'The Heaven's Mandate Return to Void Art'? Breaking free from Heaven's shackles? He unconsciously gripped the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve tighter, an indescribable emotion surging in his heart. Could this tome perhaps have some connection to the Tianji Record itself?

dialogue.content: (Suddenly speaking softly) By the way, there's something I've never had the chance to tell you. Three months ago, I saw a name in the Holy Sect's secret archives—Chen Nian. She's imprisoned in the deepest part of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, the 'Heaven's Mandate Altar', seemingly... seemingly being cultivated as some kind of sacrificial offering.

text.content: Chen Ji's body stiffened violently. His fingers trembled involuntarily for an instant, then forcibly suppressed. His sister... Chen Nian. His sister who had been missing for years. For three years, he had been searching in secret, yet never imagined she would be in the Holy Sect's hands.

dialogue.content: (Voice extremely low, yet with barely concealed trembling) Chen Nian... is she still alive?

(Eyes softening) Alive. But I don't know how much longer she can hold on. The Holy Sect's demand for 'Heaven's Mandate Key' is extremely urgent. Once the ritual preparations are complete... Chen Ji, I know you've been searching for her all along. This is the last piece of intelligence I can give you.

choice.prompt: After learning his sister's whereabouts, how does Chen Ji choose?

choices.text: Act immediately to rescue Chen Nian
choices.description: Rush to the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds to rescue his sister regardless of consequences
choices.visible_cost: Alert the enemy, exposing his intentions
choices.visible_reward: May rescue Chen Nian, but will clash with the Holy Sect head-on prematurely
choices.risk_hint: Success rate extremely low, may cost his life

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly rose, killing intent blazing in his eyes. His sister... the person he'd been searching for three years was now in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds. He almost wanted to charge out immediately, but reason splashed down like cold water—he was no match for the Holy Sect at his current level.

choices.memory_label: 陈机得知妹妹被囚禁于圣宗禁地

choices.text: Endure and wait for the right moment
choices.description: Note the intelligence and proceed according to plan, waiting for the optimal moment to act together
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, accumulating power for the larger game ahead
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may suffer misfortune during the waiting

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, taking a deep breath. When he opened them again, the surging emotions had been suppressed deep within, leaving only cold calculation: 'I've noted it. The most urgent matter now is to dismantle Ling Yuan's and the Holy Sect's schemes one by one. Chen Nian's matter... will be dealt with later.'

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择隐忍，将救陈念之事纳入长远计划

choices.description: Ask Ye Qing to use her Holy Sect connections to secretly protect Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian receives covert protection, increasing rescue success rate
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's situation becomes more dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing, a hint of earnestness in his gaze: 'Ye Qing, do you still have contacts within the Holy Sect? I need you to monitor Chen Nian's movements for me. Any changes must be reported to me immediately.'

choices.memory_label: 陈机请夜清暗中保护陈念

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at Chen Ji's expression of forcibly suppressed emotions, her heart aching slightly. She stood and walked to the window, her back to Chen Ji as she spoke softly: 'Three years ago, when we first met in that valley, you were severely wounded, being pursued by the three major sects. I asked why you didn't beg for mercy, and you said—' She paused, her voice carrying a hint of a smile, 'You said, if begging for mercy worked, there would be no dead people in this world.'

dialogue.content: (Turning around, eyes gentle) Even then I knew you were a fool who swallowed all bitterness alone. These three years, how many schemes you've laid, how many worries you've borne—I've seen it all clearly. So... whatever decision you make, I will stand on your side. Even if it costs my life.

(Approaching him, reaching out to straighten his slightly disheveled collar, the gesture tender) Chen Ji, there's only one thing I want you to remember—you are not fighting alone. No matter how unpredictable Heaven's mandate, I will walk this path with you until the very end.

text.content: Under the moonlight, Ye Qing's face was cold yet carried a unique gentleness. Chen Ji gazed at her, suddenly remembering that rainy night three years ago when she stood before him, covered in blood, speaking those words he still remembered vividly: 'I want to live. I want to see how far you can go.'

dialogue.content: (Voice low, yet carrying rare warmth) Ye Qing, three years ago you asked me how far I could go. I couldn't answer then. But now... I want to take you to see what kind of scenery lies at the end of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Hearing this, Ye Qing's eyes slightly reddened, yet she still wore that cold expression. She nodded gently, stepping back and tidying her hair, restoring her Saintess demeanor. 'Remember your words.' She turned toward the window, her form already beginning to merge with the night, 'The next time we meet, I may no longer be who I am now. Take care.'

Her words fell, and Ye Qing's figure had completely vanished into the night. Only a lingering wisp of that ethereal fragrance in the air proved she had come. Chen Ji stood alone by the window, gazing toward where she disappeared, the blood-stained Jade Pendant tightly clutched in his hand. Ling Yuan's chess game had been set in motion, the Holy Sect's conspiracy pressed closer with each step, and his sister... still waited in that lightless Forbidden Grounds for rescue.

Chen Ji withdrew his gaze and sat back at the table. He unfolded the impeachment memorial from Ling Yuan and took out the Jade Pendant Ye Qing had left, comparing the two. Tianji Pavilion ruins, Blood Slaughter Elder, 'The Heaven's Mandate Return to Void Art', Chen Nian—all the clues intertwined in his mind into an enormous chess game. The corners of his mouth lifted slightly, yet his eyes held only cold killing intent. Ling Yuan, since you've made your move, don't blame me for abandoning fellow sect member courtesy.
Night wind brushed past, stirring the candle flame on Chen Ji's desk. He picked up his brush and dipped it in ink, beginning to write a secret letter—the recipient:
